move: title rises, icon discs pop in spinning, ring ripple, bounce wave, exit
how: A cream stage. The title rises from an overflow mask (yPercent 110 to 0, expo.out). From 6% five coloured discs scale from 0 with rotation -60 and a 0.1s back.out(2) stagger, their glyphs following with back.out(3) and the handles rising from masks. At 32% a coloured ring on each disc scales 1 to 1.55 and fades in the same stagger; at 55% the discs lift y -12 and drop with bounce.out in a wave. From 84% handles and discs exit reversed (scale 0, rotation 60, back.in) and the title drops out of its mask.
adapt: Replace the five brand colours, glyph SVGs and handles, and the title; add or remove discs; keep the back.out(2) 0.7s pop and the 0.1s stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the title and N discs from shot.accounts; animate returns the timeline with pop at 0.06D, ripple at 0.32D, wave at 0.55D and exit at 0.84D. Direct port; scope selectors to el and use immediateRender:false on the from() tweens if composed.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when composed
